mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 69 degrees with overcast skies near Verona City Hall under a beautiful Full Moon.

The City of Verona has launched an effort to update its Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a long-term guide for growth. This eighteen-month project, overseen by a special task force, will shape everything from housing to economic development through 2026.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can visit the Downtown Farmer's Market, enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness, grab pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or head to The Bogey Factory for Trivia Night. Tomorrow, make sure to stop by Hop Haus for their weekly trivia session.
On August 19, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash at North Main Street and Bering Drive where two drivers were cited for traffic violations following minor injuries.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. Our local Culver's is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM and remain open until 10:00 PM.
